selected_stream_kernel.description: one standard STREAM kernel whose native best rate is reported

supported_thread_count.description: positive OpenMP thread count, limited at run time by the effective CPU set

prepared_array_variant.description: installed STREAM array size in MiB per array

cpu_node_or_inherited.description: none to inherit the effective CPU mask, or an available NUMA node ID

memory_node_or_inherited.description: none to inherit memory policy, or an allowed NUMA memory node ID

bounded_deadline.description: native process deadline in seconds, from 30 through 3600
